To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The death cause from cardiovascular disease was erroneous in 40-50%, due to defects in the postmortal examination and the analysis of the death certificates.
the death cause in the Ukrainian SSR from cardiovascular diseases was erroneously diagnosed in 5- 40% due to incorrect postmortal diagnosis, or analysis.
the quality of postmortem diagnosis and death certificates of circulatory diseases in Ukraine is not high and requires improvement.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the analysis of the causes of the death of patients with cardiovascular disease, and the analysis of the quality of the diagnosis of the causes of death of patients with these diseases in the postmortal period.
the problem of the quality of diagnosis of circulatory disease as the main cause in the Ukrainian SSR and the development of measures to improve it.

the problem of improving the quality of postmortem diagnosis in the Ukrainian SSR and with the development of organizational measures to improve postmortem diagnosis and the quality of entries in death certificates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of postmortem diagnosis in the Ukrainian SSR was poor.
the death cause was erroneous in 10-40% of the cases due to defects in the postmortal diagnoses and/or the analysis of death certificates.
cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death in Ukraine, and that this is a serious problem that requires immediate and effective action.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the death cause of cardiovascular diseases is not a reliable criterion in assessing the effectiveness of the prophylactic work on cardiovascular diseases.

the quality of postmortem diagnosis and registration of causes of death from cardiovascular diseases is unsatisfactory and needs to be improved by improving the organization of the postmortem diagnosis.
the quality of postmortem diagnosis in the regions of the Ukrainian Republic is low and requires improvement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important to ensure the quality of postmortem diagnosis and the analysis of the death certificates.
there is a need to develop and implement a system to monitor the quality of postmortem diagnosis in the regions of Ukraine.
the quality of postmortem diagnosis of circulatory disease in Ukraine is poor, with the death cause from circulatory diseases being incorrectly formulated in 5–40% of cases, depending on the region.
